newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-BZW cuts Matthey estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BZW cuts Matthey estimates.

text.p: Estimates for pre-tax profit at precious metals group Johnson Matthey Plc were cut at BZW, market sources said on Monday.
For the year ending March 1997 the brokerage cut its estimate to 116 million stg from 122 million and for 1998 it cut to 136 million stg from 142 million.
But the brokerage repeated a "buy" rating on the stock, which was down 2p at 576 by 1053 GMT.

Sources said BZW's forecast cuts reflected tough trading in Matthey's electronic materials and ceramics units, though the brokerage said the group's investment particularly in the electronics field made the stock attractive in the longer term.
